pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn with a Flowing Mane and Curled Tail Surrounded By Stars and Hearts Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn has a flowing mane and curled tail in this printable coloring page, sitting on a cloud beneath a broad rainbow. Stars and hearts surround the smiling cat, while the striped horn, layered mane sections, small paws, and spiral tail add clear details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn with a Flower-braided Mane in a Blooming Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn sits in a blooming garden in this printable coloring page, with flowers tucked through a long braided mane. A rose-covered arch rises above a picket fence, while simple blooms, leafy stems, grass tufts, a striped horn, and a flowing tail complete the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn with Feathered Wings Flying Over a Rainbow Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn flies over a rainbow with feathered wings in this printable coloring page, stretching both wings beside the rounded body. The striped horn, windblown mane, long layered tail, small raised paws, scattered stars, and fluffy clouds create separate shapes across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Crossing a Rainbow Bridge Between Fluffy Clouds Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn crosses a rainbow bridge between fluffy clouds in this printable coloring page, lifting one front paw as the mane streams behind. A striped horn and long curved tail accompany outlined stars, four-pointed sparkles, layered rainbow bands, and a distant castle above the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Sleeping on a Crescent Moon Above the Clouds Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen Unicorn sleeping on a crescent moon above the clouds. A flowing mane and long striped tail curve around the resting cat, while stars, diamond-shaped sparkles, and a small rainbow fill the sky in this dreamy coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Hugging a Star on a Fluffy Cloud Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn hugs a large star while sitting on a fluffy cloud in this printable coloring page. The upright cat has a striped horn, sweeping mane, and flowing tail, with both front paws wrapped around the star at the center of this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Watching a Meteor Shower From a Grassy Hilltop Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen Unicorn watching a meteor shower from a grassy hilltop. Shooting stars streak across the sky above the smiling cat, while scattered rocks, tufts of grass, distant hills, and evergreen trees complete the nighttime setting in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Floating Beside a Ringed Planet Among Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn floats beside a ringed planet among stars in this printable coloring page. The cat's paws curl forward beneath a striped horn, and its long mane and tail sweep to one side, surrounded by stars and small circles throughout the space-themed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Riding in a Hot Air Balloon Above the Clouds Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen Unicorn riding in a hot air balloon above the clouds. The cat rests its front paws on a woven basket beneath a large paneled balloon, with scalloped decorations, suspension ropes, and billowing clouds adding detail to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Blowing Bubbles Beneath a Rainbow Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn blows bubbles beneath a rainbow in this printable coloring page. One paw holds a bubble wand near its mouth while the other grips a small bottle, and round bubbles rise beside the cat beneath cloud-tipped rainbow arches in this outdoor coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Drawing a Rainbow with Crayons at a Small Desk Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen Unicorn drawing a rainbow with crayons at a small desk. The smiling cat sits on a chair and holds a crayon over a cloud-ended rainbow drawing, with three extra crayons scattered across the tabletop in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Wearing a Fairy Dress and Holding a Star Wand Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn wears a fairy dress and holds a star wand in this printable coloring page. Butterfly-shaped wings, frilled cuffs, and a heart-centered waist bow decorate the outfit, while floating stars and sparkles surround the cat's striped horn and flowing mane in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Wearing a Crown Beside a Small Fairytale Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen Unicorn wearing a crown beside a small fairytale castle. A heart decorates the crown around its striped horn, while flagged towers, an arched double door, flowering bushes, and a stepping-stone path frame the cat in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Chasing a Butterfly Through a Flower Meadow Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn chases a butterfly through a flower meadow in this printable coloring page. The leaping cat reaches forward with an open smile as its mane and tail stream behind, and a dotted butterfly trail curls above the blossoms and grassy tufts in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Smelling a Daisy Beside a Garden Fence Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen Unicorn smelling a daisy beside a garden fence. The cat leans its nose toward a tall flower with a leafy stem, while pointed fence boards, rounded bushes, and small grass clumps provide the garden setting in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Resting Outside a Cozy Cottage Under a Rainbow Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn rests outside a cozy cottage under a rainbow in this printable coloring page. Flowers line the foreground around the reclining cat, while the cottage has an arched door, a chimney, a flower-filled window box, and a garden fence in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Sheltering Under an Umbrella as a Rainbow Appears After Rain Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen Unicorn sheltering under an umbrella as a rainbow appears after rain. The cat grips the curved handle with both paws while standing in a rippling puddle, with raindrops, smaller pools, and rounded bushes filling this rainy-day coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Splashing in a Puddle Reflecting a Rainbow Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn splashes in a puddle reflecting a rainbow in this printable coloring page. Water sprays around its feet beneath a cloud-ended rainbow, and the puddle mirrors the cat's face and striped horn, adding an upside-down detail to this playful outdoor coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Floating in a Unicorn Pool Ring Beside the Beach Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen Unicorn floating in a unicorn pool ring beside the beach. Small waves surround the inflatable ring, while a shell and starfish rest on the nearby shore beneath a sun, clouds, and a coconut palm in this seaside coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Ice Skating on a Frozen Pond Beneath a Winter Rainbow Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn ice skates on a frozen pond beneath a winter rainbow in this printable coloring page. The smiling cat glides with one skate lifted behind it, while curving skate marks, snowy banks, and snow-covered pine trees complete the scene in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Building a Snowman with Stormy Beside a Snowy Pine Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen Unicorn building a snowman with Stormy beside a snowy pine tree. Pusheen holds a snowball above the carrot-nosed snowman while fluffy Stormy carries another, surrounded by snowbanks, twig arms, and round snowman buttons in this winter coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Having a Picnic with Stormy Beneath a Rainbow Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn has a picnic with Stormy beneath a rainbow in this printable coloring page. Pusheen holds a triangular sandwich and Stormy nibbles a cookie, while a woven basket, apples, and a plate of snacks sit on the checked blanket in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Curled Inside a Giant Sprinkled Donut Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen Unicorn curled inside a giant sprinkled donut. The cat rests its front paws over the donut's inner edge, with a striped horn, swept mane, and flowing tail rising above the thick icing and scattered sprinkles in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Licking Ice Cream From a Waffle Cone Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn licks ice cream from a waffle cone in this printable coloring page. Both paws hold the crosshatched cone beneath a dripping scoop dotted with sprinkles, while hearts and stars float around the cat's striped horn and wavy mane in this sweet coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Hugging a Giant Cupcake Topped with a Unicorn Horn Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen Unicorn hugging a giant cupcake topped with a unicorn horn. The oversized treat has swirled frosting, star decorations, scattered sprinkles, and a pleated wrapper, with the cat's paws and flowing tail framing the cupcake in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Stirring Cake Batter in a Kitchen Mixing Bowl Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn stirs cake batter in a kitchen mixing bowl in this printable coloring page. A whisk dips into the heart-patterned bowl beside eggs, butter, and a measuring jug, while shelves, jars, hanging utensils, and a window fill the background of this baking coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Cutting Star-shaped Cookies From Rolled Dough Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen Unicorn cutting star-shaped cookies from rolled dough. The cat presses a star cutter beside a rolling pin and mixing bowl, with loose cookies, a filled baking tray, a hanging towel, and a potted plant completing this kitchen coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Sipping Bubble Tea at a Cafe Table Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn sips bubble tea at a cafe table in this printable coloring page. The cat drinks through a wide straw from a pearl-filled cup beside a small flower vase, with an awning, hanging lights, extra chairs, and paving stones completing the cafe coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Eating a Slice of Rainbow Layer Cake Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen Unicorn eating a slice of rainbow layer cake. The cat holds a striped cake slice topped with sprinkles and a frosting swirl, while a cloud-ended rainbow, floating hearts, and stars surround its long mane in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Serving Ice Cream From a Rainbow-striped Cart Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn serves ice cream from a rainbow-striped cart in this printable coloring page. Wearing a heart-decorated apron, the cat holds a filled cone and an ice cream scoop beneath a large umbrella, with ice cream tubs and stacked waffle cones in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Eating a Pizza Slice Beside a Rainbow Kitchen Window Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen Unicorn eating a pizza slice beside a rainbow kitchen window. Mushrooms and round toppings cover the triangular slice, while an open pizza box, hanging oven mitt, utensil holder, and trailing potted plant furnish the kitchen in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Holding Cloud-shaped Cotton Candy at a Fair Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn holds cloud-shaped cotton candy at a fair in this printable coloring page. The fluffy treat carries tiny hearts, stars, and sprinkles, while a Ferris wheel, striped cotton candy stall, triangular bunting, and a waving flag fill the background of this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Celebrating Her Birthday Beside a Rainbow Cake with Candles Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen Unicorn celebrating her birthday beside a rainbow cake with candles. Five lit candles rise above frosting swirls on the layered cake, surrounded by wrapped presents, heart-shaped balloons, scattered confetti, and a large rainbow in this party coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Opening a Birthday Gift Beneath Star-shaped Balloons Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn opens a birthday gift beneath star-shaped balloons in this printable coloring page. The cat lifts a bow-topped lid from a star-patterned box filled with tissue paper, while extra presents, curled ribbons, and scattered confetti complete the celebration in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Cuddling a Heart-shaped Pillow Beneath Hanging Hearts Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen Unicorn cuddling a heart-shaped pillow beneath hanging hearts. The large cushion has a scalloped frill around its edge, and the cat sits on a tasseled floor pillow with smaller floating hearts beside its sweeping mane in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Peeking Into a Refrigerator Filled with Snacks Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn peeks into a refrigerator filled with snacks in this printable coloring page. A strawberry-topped cake, cookies, cupcakes, donuts, and fruit fill the shelves, while bottles, jars, and a carton line the open door beside the cat in this detailed kitchen coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Relaxing in a Cloud-shaped Bathtub Filled with Bubbles Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen Unicorn relaxing in a cloud-shaped bathtub filled with bubbles. The cat holds a sudsy bath brush beside a rubber duck, with a towel draped over the tub and heart-decorated containers on a wall shelf in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Playing Video Games with Stormy on a Sofa Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn plays video games with Stormy on a sofa in this printable coloring page. Both cats hold wired controllers facing a television, while a popcorn bowl, star-decorated mug, heart cushion, fringed blanket, and curtained window furnish the living room in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Watching Television with a Bowl of Popcorn Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen Unicorn watching television with a bowl of popcorn. The cat lifts a piece toward its mouth while seated in an armchair, with a heart cushion, draped blanket, floor lamp, potted plant, and oval rug completing this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Reading a Book Under a Cozy Blanket Beside a Window Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn reads a book under a cozy blanket beside a window in this printable coloring page. Stars and hearts decorate the blanket around the seated cat, while a crescent moon shines outside and a heart-decorated mug rests on stacked books in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Hugging a Teddy Bear on a Star-patterned Bed Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen Unicorn hugging a teddy bear on a star-patterned bed. The bear wears a tied bow beneath its smiling face, while a rounded headboard, bow-tied curtains, and hanging moon and star decorations frame the bedroom in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Snuggling with Stormy in a Cozy Blanket Nest Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn snuggles with Stormy in a cozy blanket nest in this printable coloring page. Hearts and stars cover the piled blankets around the cuddling cats, with patterned pillows, a cat-shaped cushion, a marshmallow-filled mug, and a moonlit window adding details to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Brushing Her Long Mane at a Dressing-table Mirror Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen Unicorn brushing her long mane at a dressing-table mirror. Her horn and face appear in the oval reflection, while a heart-topped mirror frame, grooming brushes, a small lidded box, and a bow-decorated bottle fill this bedroom coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Peeking Out of a Cardboard Box Decorated with Rainbows Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn peeks out of a cardboard box decorated with rainbows in this printable coloring page. Both front paws rest on an open flap as its wavy mane and long tail spill above the box, with floating clouds and stars completing this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Playing with a Ball of Yarn on a Cloud-patterned Rug Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen Unicorn playing with a ball of yarn on a cloud-patterned rug. A loose strand curls across the rug beneath the cat's paw, while a leafy plant and a smiling star ornament on a small cabinet furnish this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Listening to Music with Headphones Beside a Stack of Pillows Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn listens to music with headphones beside a stack of pillows in this printable coloring page. Stars decorate the ear cups and handheld music player, while floating musical notes, striped and dotted cushions, and a fluffy floor mat surround the cat in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Playing a Small Guitar Beneath Floating Musical Notes Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen Unicorn playing a small guitar beneath floating musical notes. One paw rests over the strings and the other holds the neck, with a rainbow, scattered stars, and grass tufts surrounding the seated cat in this musical coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Wearing a Cozy Sweater and Holding a Warm Mug By the Fireplace Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn wears a cozy sweater and holds a warm mug by the fireplace in this printable coloring page. Hearts and stars decorate the sweater beside burning logs, with marshmallows in the steaming mug and snowy pine trees visible through the window in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Sipping Tea with Pip Beside a Plate of Star-shaped Cookies Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen Unicorn sipping tea with Pip beside a plate of star-shaped cookies. Matching star-decorated cups sit above a scalloped tablecloth, while an arched window, patterned curtain, and leafy potted plant frame the two cats in this tea-party coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn Carrying a Tray of Cupcakes at a Rainbow-themed Bakery Stall Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn carries a tray of cupcakes at a rainbow-themed bakery stall in this printable coloring page. Three star-topped cupcakes sit on the tray, with more treats on tiered stands and beneath a display dome, framed by a striped awning and rainbow in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn in Winter Village Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen Unicorn in a winter village wearing a long striped scarf. Small stars decorate the flowing mane above the cat's rounded cheeks, while snow-covered cottages, bare trees, evergreen saplings, and a steepled building spread across the hills in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn in Donut Shop Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn sits in a donut shop holding a bitten sprinkled donut in this printable coloring page. A flower rests beside the striped horn, while a pastry display case, cash register, illustrated menu board, and shelf of jars and plants surround the stool in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn By the Fireplace Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Pusheen Unicorn by the fireplace with a flower necklace and star-decorated mane. Small wings extend behind the smiling cat, while burning logs, a mantel clock, patterned mugs, potted plants, and a fringed rug add details to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn in Dining Room Coloring Page
pages.description: Pusheen Unicorn stands in a dining room wearing a star pendant in this printable coloring page. The striped horn and long mane rise beside a wooden chair, while a bowl on a plate, a mug, a curtain, and a small potted plant furnish this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Pusheen Unicorn in Rainbow Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Pusheen Unicorn in a rainbow garden with flowers tucked into its mane. A small wing rises beside the cat, surrounded by tall blossoms, leafy heart-shaped buds, floating stars, clouds, and a sun above the rainbow arches in this coloring sheet.
